questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of monetization for high school content creators?

options.text: To focus only on making money and ignore creative content
To turn digital content into a source of income while pursuing a passion
To stop creating content once you earn a small amount
To spend all earnings immediately without saving or planning

correct_answer.text: To turn digital content into a source of income while pursuing a passion

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of earning through ad revenue as a teen creator?

options.text: Promoting a brand’s product in a video for a one-time payment
Sharing an affiliate link for a product and earning a commission per sale
Getting paid by YouTube for views on your videos after joining the Partner Program
Selling your own merchandise directly to followers

correct_answer.text: Getting paid by YouTube for views on your videos after joining the Partner Program

questions.question_text: Why is building a portfolio of digital content important for high school students?

options.text: It helps showcase your best work to impress brands, clients, or schools for future opportunities
It is only useful if you already have millions of followers
It prevents you from creating new content by focusing on old posts
It is a way to delete old content and start fresh

correct_answer.text: It helps showcase your best work to impress brands, clients, or schools for future opportunities

questions.question_text: How can exploring careers in content creation, filmmaking, or digital marketing benefit high school students?

options.text: It guarantees an immediate full-time job without finishing school
It helps identify potential passions or career paths and builds skills for college or future gigs
It forces students to choose a career before they are ready
It is irrelevant until after high school graduation

correct_answer.text: It helps identify potential passions or career paths and builds skills for college or future gigs

questions.question_text: What is a key strategy for balancing content creation with studies and personal life as a high schooler?

options.text: Ignoring schoolwork to focus entirely on creating content for more views
Setting a schedule for content, studies, and downtime while prioritizing mental health
Posting content every day regardless of exams or personal stress
Avoiding breaks from content creation to maintain follower growth

correct_answer.text: Setting a schedule for content, studies, and downtime while prioritizing mental health
